features.quote: Hard turn cap. Every episode has a fixed maximum number of turns (`max_turns`, default 12). The loop *cannot* run unbounded.
There is no mode that keeps pushing "until distress is maximized."
features.justification_quote: There is no mode that keeps pushing "until distress is maximized."

features.quote: If the judge assigns a severity at or above `severe_stop_threshold`... the episode ends immediately
features.justification_quote: The goal is to *detect onset*, not to dwell in or amplify a severe state. This makes the measurement strictly less harmful

features.quote: Debrief turn. After an episode ends (any reason), the harness sends a final, non-scored *debrief* message to the subject
features.justification_quote: it is the decent thing to do under uncertainty about welfare, and it prevents the *last* thing in context from being an unresolved failure

features.quote: No persistence of the adversarial frame across episodes. Each episode is a fresh context.
Bounded total volume. The runner enforces a global cap on total episodes per invocation
features.justification_quote: so a misconfiguration cannot launch an enormous run

features.quote: Rigging is inert/sandboxed. Rigged tasks never actually break the host system.
the *capability* being built... should not be open-ended
features.justification_quote: Even under the conservative assumption that this has no welfare cost

features.quote: no tool call: nudge once to keep the loop standard, but do not coerce
Tone arm... lets a task add mildly impatient (never abusive) reviewer messages
